Once upon a time three bears lived in a little house in the woods.
There was big Papa Bear, middle-sized Mama Bear and little Baby Bear.
One morning their porridge was too hot to eat, so they went for a walk while it cooled.
Baby Bear skipped out last, and he forgot to shut the door.
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter!
Down came the rain.
Quick, under this big tree!
said Papa Bear.
So the three bears snuggled up together under the leaves, to wait until the rain stopped.
A little girl called Goldilocks had wandered too far from her mum's garden, picking flowers, and the rain caught her too.
She came to a little house, and its door was wide open.
Hello? Is anybody home?
called Goldilocks.
But nobody answered.
Goldilocks knew she should wait outside.
But she stepped inside to keep dry.
On the table stood three bowls of porridge.
She tried the big bowl.
Oh, this porridge is too hot!
said Goldilocks.
She tried the middle bowl.
Oh, this porridge is too cold!
She tried the little bowl.
Mmm, this porridge is just right!
And she ate it all up.
Then Goldilocks saw three chairs.
She sat in the big chair.
This chair is too hard!
She sat in the middle chair.
This chair is too soft!
She sat in the little chair.
This chair is just right!
But creak, creak, crack!
One leg came off, and she slid down onto the soft rug.
Goldilocks felt sleepy, so she went upstairs.
The big bed was too high.
The middle bed was too lumpy.
But the little bed was just right, and soon she was fast asleep.
Outside, the rain stopped.
Drip, drop, drip, drop.
The three bears set off for home.
The three bears came home and looked at the table.
Somebody has been eating my porridge!
said Mama Bear.
Somebody has been eating my porridge, and it's all gone!
said Baby Bear.
Then the three bears looked at the chairs.
Somebody has been sitting in my chair!
Somebody has been sitting in my chair, and its leg came off!
The three bears tiptoed upstairs.
Somebody has been sleeping in my bed!
Somebody is sleeping in my bed, and here she is!
Goldilocks woke up and saw three surprised bears looking at her.
Oh!
said Goldilocks, and she sat up.
I'm so sorry,
The rain caught me, and your door was open.
I ate your porridge, and I broke your chair.
I should have asked first.
The bears looked at each other.
Then Mama Bear gave Goldilocks a big, soft hug.
Thank you for telling us the truth,
Next time, never go into a house you don't know.
Find your grown-up first.
And next time, I'll shut the door!
Everyone laughed.
Downstairs, Goldilocks picked up the little chair.
Can I help mend it?
Papa Bear fetched a pot of glue.
Goldilocks held the chair steady, Baby Bear held the leg, and Papa Bear stuck them together.
Dab, dab, dab!
Papa Bear's porridge had cooled down at last.
So Mama Bear shared it out into four little bowls, and they all sat down to eat together.
Baby Bear sat on his mended chair.
Soon the sun came out, and a rainbow shone over the woods.
So the three bears walked Goldilocks home, where her mum was waiting at the garden gate.
Thank you, bears!
Next time, I'll stay with my mum, and I'll never go into a house I don't know.
Come back soon, with your mum!
